title: CMS - LTACH Requirements | NHSN | CDC
content: CMS – Long-term Acute Care Facilities (LTACH) Print Minus Related Pages View operational guidance and resources for Long-term Acute Care Facilities (LTACHs) to report data to NHSN for fulfilling CMS’s Hospital Inpatient Quality Reporting (IQR) Requirements.
